action.description: "list" returns all MCP servers; "read" returns a server's config; "create" creates a new server; "update" modifies an existing one; "delete" removes a server; "test" tests the connection; "discover" scans opencode/claude/cursor configs for MCP servers on this machine; "import" imports discovered servers by name.

name.description: Required for read/create/update/delete/import. The MCP server name.

names.description: Comma-separated server names to import (required when action="import").

command.description: Required for create. The command to start the MCP server.

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process.

description: List, read, create, update, delete, test, discover, or import MCP server configurations
author: TianShu
name: mcp_manager
